entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Derdian leader rose to leave, t..."
entries.dialogueText: The Derdian leader rose to leave, then sat back down with a thoughtful look on his face.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Your Majesty... did you know that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty... did you know that a former member of your royal household has recently claimed asylum in Derdia?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is it the Princess?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is it the Princess?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I did not know that. But it does n..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did not know that. But it does not come as surprising news."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What? You must extradite this pers..."
entries.dialogueText: "What? You must extradite this person immediately."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My butler Pabel Adria, I presume?..."
entries.dialogueText: "My butler Pabel Adria, I presume? He mentioned he had friends there."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""None other.""
entries.dialogueText: "None other."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""No. A man by the name of Pabel Adr..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. A man by the name of Pabel Adria."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I presume it is someone involved i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I presume it is someone involved in Princess Vina's recent disappearance?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""That may be possible.""
entries.dialogueText: "That may be possible."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""That won't be possible.""
entries.dialogueText: "That won't be possible."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""The man, Pabel Adria, claims he wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The man, Pabel Adria, claims he will be unjustly persecuted if he returns to Rizia. But if you deem his crime worthy of punishment, you may have him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He assisted in my daughter's disap..."
entries.dialogueText: "He assisted in my daughter's disappearance. He might have information about where she is."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Mr. Adria claims he will be unjust..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Adria claims he will be unjustly persecuted if he returns to Rizia. But if you deem his crime worthy of punishment by your laws, you may have him."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""This man, Pabel Adria, claims he w..."
entries.dialogueText: "This man, Pabel Adria, claims he will be unjustly persecuted if he returns to Rizia. But if you deem his crime worthy of punishment by your laws, you may have him."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Then you know that I cannot help y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then you know that I cannot help you should you wish Pabel Adria's extradition to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you, Supreme Wiseman. Nobody..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Supreme Wiseman. Nobody betrays the King of Rizia without consequences."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, leave him be. Punishing him wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, leave him be. Punishing him would accomplish nothing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, send him here. He was complic..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, send him here. He was complicit in my daughter's escape. He might have information about where she is."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't understand. Nobody betra..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't understand. Nobody betrays the King of Rizia and gets away with it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How can you say that? Do you even..."
entries.dialogueText: "How can you say that? Do you even know what he did?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""According to the Derdian Constitut..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to the Derdian Constitution, we are obliged to offer sanctuary to those facing persecution due to their practice of the most sacred form of love."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Without exception.""
entries.dialogueText: "Without exception."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would not expect your assistance..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would not expect your assistance in this matter. What happened is between Mr. Adria and myself."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Wruhec himself would admire your m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wruhec himself would admire your mercy."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""We do not use such labels in Derdi..."
entries.dialogueText: "We do not use such labels in Derdia. And we do not imprison men when a divine spark ignites between them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't understand. Are you saying..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't understand. Are you saying my butler was a homosexual?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand. May God forgive him,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. May God forgive him, then."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Love wasn't his crime. Abetting my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Love wasn't his crime. Abetting my daughter's escape was."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal nodded sagely."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal nodded sagely.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I will not ask what happened. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not ask what happened. But I hope the Lord shows you both mercy."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""And yet Rizia would have him punis..."
entries.dialogueText: "And yet Rizia would have him punished for either."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The most sacred form of love is be..."
entries.dialogueText: "The most sacred form of love is between a man and a woman."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Is that what you believe, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is that what you believe, Your Majesty? Or are you parroting the words of your flawed Sanctuary?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have you ever actually been with a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you ever actually been with a man, Supreme Wiseman? There's nothing sacred about it."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""That is in the eye of the beholder..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is in the eye of the beholder, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I do not want to put a taint on wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not want to put a taint on what we have accomplished today. But I unfortunately cannot assist in returning him to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Very well. I'll give the orders wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. I'll give the orders when I arrive back at the Garrison."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal shook his head."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal shook his head.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal nodded.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""As long as he faces danger upon re..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as he faces danger upon returning to Rizia, Pabel Adria must remain in Derdia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stood up, shook my hand and left..."
entries.dialogueText: He stood up, shook my hand and left the suite.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I will not ask you to change your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not ask you to change your kingdom's laws."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""But I hope that someday you and yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I hope that someday you and your people will see things the way we do. The way St. Wruhec intended."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""May the Lord be with you.""
entries.dialogueText: "May the Lord be with you."
